notes: «حَدَّثَني مَن سَمِعَ» is an unnamed transmitter (rule 8), placed before the named Nawfali.
The Nawfali speaks the report («يَقُولُ لَمَّا قَدِمَ ...»), so he is the last link; Ali b. Musa and Yasir are in the scene, not links.
